title.en: What Is Yours to Answer For? · Eight Languages

summary.en: Three complete essays now add German, French, Spanish, Japanese and Korean editions. Every workplace and parenting example is retained, with independent cross-review and corrections to the distinction between an operative demand and a justified one. Existing English and Chinese prose is unchanged.
summary.zh: 新增德法西日韩五语全文，完整保留岗位、交接、退出与孩子成长的例子和论证。经逐段交叉审核与局部修正，分清要求成立、正当性与实际兑现；原有中英繁正文不变。
